Waydev Core engineering effectiveness is measured across four dimensions: effectiveness, speed, quality, and impact. **Waydev Core 4** is the unified model that combines these dimensions into a single dashboard, built on the DX Core 4™ framework developed by Nicole Forsgren and the DX research team. If your team has struggled to connect code-level activity to business outcomes, this is where that gap closes.


**TL;DR:** Waydev Core 4 consolidates DORA, SPACE, and DevEx research into one model. It benchmarks your teams against P50, P75, and P90 industry percentiles and ships alongside Hygiene 2.0 for drill-down analysis at Group, Team, or Nested Team level.


### The Four Dimensions of Waydev Core 4


The framework organizes insights into four core dimensions that reflect how engineering teams operate day to day:


- **Effectiveness:** It measures how consistently the changes in code go through review. It reflects team collaboration, communication, and quality discipline.
- **Speed:** A metric that tracks the speed of work from commit to production, giving leaders clarity on delivery efficiency and time-to-value.
- **Quality:** It monitors the frequency of deployments that fail or require fixes to show just how reliable and stable the delivery process really is.
- **Impact:** This measures the amount of new value-creating work teams deliver versus maintenance or rework, which points to where innovation thrives.


By combining system data with contextual insights,[Core 4](https://app.waydev.co/login) by Waydev lets organizations balance speed with stability and innovation; it makes sure decisions are data-driven and oriented toward outcomes.


### **Industry Percentile Benchmarks**


Every engineering team wants to know where they stand. To make that transparent, Waydev Core 4 introduces percentile benchmarks that compare performance across the industry:


- **P50, Median Performance:** This is the 50th percentile, representative of the industry average, which will help teams set a consistent baseline and find areas for improvement.
- **P75, Top-Quartile Performance:** The 75th percentile describes teams outperforming three-quarters of their peers while exemplifying strong maturity, velocity, and collaboration.
- **P90, Elite Performance:** The 90th percentile is where world-class teams bring together extraordinary speed with high quality and effectiveness, coupled with mature engineering practices.


These benchmarks put your data into context, enabling teams to set meaningful goals and celebrate measurable progress.


### A New Generation of Insight: Hygiene 2.0


Accompanying Waydev Core 4, we’re also releasing **Hygiene 2.0** , rebuilt from the ground up for deeper and more flexible analysis. It’s now possible to filter insights at Group, Team, or Nested Teams levels for detailed performance reviews and targeted improvements.


It gets even better: each of those graphs is interactive, so click any metric to show the exact unlinked PRs behind the metric. Now it’s easier than ever to trace performance patterns, reveal process gaps, and verify that things are properly aligned in engineering workflows.
